_README: The template bank. Shapes, not questions: every slot is filled from a line
the owner confirmed on the fact sheet or from the session's run inputs, so
every generated query is traceable to something a human vouched for.
NO LLM WRITES ENTRIES HERE. docs/query-generation-plan.md §1b forbids
LLM-originated queries — source, draft, format, never originate. Adding a
shape is a human editorial act, and `provenance` records how it was sourced:
verbatim       lifted from a real buyer's words (a review, a support
near_verbatim  a real phrasing with the brand or place swapped out
constructed    a pure shape nobody said in these words
A shape whose slots cannot all be filled is DROPPED, never partially filled:
a literal {city} reaching an engine scores as a loss on a question nobody
asked. Keys are IntentBucket values; both funnels live in one file because
the local fallback and the product path share the brand and comparison banks.
